units: <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 54b:9">Ab. Zar. 54ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <he>תהיה</he>, <cite ref="Leviticus 25:12">Lev. XXV, 12</cite>) <he>בהַוְיָיתָהּ תהא</he> it shall remain in its status.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 2:4:6">Y. Ber. II, 4ᵈ</cite> bot. (ref. to <he>והיו</he>, <cite ref="Deuteronomy 6:6">Deut. VI, 6</cite>) <he>כדרך הַוְיָיתָן יהו</he> they shall remain (be read) in the order in which they stand. Y. Shek. IV, 48ᵇ top <he>שתהא ה׳ בקודש</he> that it must retain its sacred character.

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 6:4:2">Cant. R. to VI, 4</cite> (ref. to <he>והיו</he>, <cite ref="Numbers 7:5">Num. VII, 5</cite>) <he>נתן להם ה׳</he> he gave them stability; <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 12:1">Num. R. s. 12</cite>, end <he>ניתן להם ה׳</he> (read <he>ניתנה</he>).

M. Kat. 15ᵃ הויה the use of the word היה in the Biblical text; Men. 28ᵃ; a. e.—Esp. (with ref. to והיתה לאיש, Deut. XXIV, 2, v. הָיָה Pi.) legal status of marriage, Kidd. 5ᵃ מקיש ה׳ ליציאה וכ׳ the text puts entrance into marriage on an equality with going out (divorce), as divorce takes place by means of a deed, so may marriage be contracted &c.

<cite ref="Yevamot 13b:4">Yeb. 13ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <he>לא תהיה</he>, <cite ref="Deuteronomy 25:5">Deut. XXV, 5</cite>) <he>לא תהיה בה ה׳ לזר</he> she shall have no legal status with another man; Y. ib. I, 2ᶜ bot. <he>לא תהא לה ה׳ וכ׳</he> (not <he>יהא</he>); a. fr.—Pl. <he>הֲוָיוֹת</he>, <cite ref="E00247"><he>הֲוָו׳</he></cite>.

Keth. 46ᵇ, a. e. איתקוש ה׳ להדדי the various modes of entrance into marriage correspond to each other.—2) הֲ׳, or הַוָּיָה (v. preced. Pa.) discussion, argument. Y. Maasr. II, 49ᵈ bot. הוו׳ דר׳ מנא the result of a discussion stated by R. M.—Pl. הֲוָיוֹת or הַוָּ׳.

<cite ref="Sukkah 28a:7">Succ. 28ᵃ</cite> <he>ה׳ דאביי וכ׳</he> (Ms. M. sing.) arguments raised by A. &c.; <cite ref="Bava Batra 134a:8">B. Bath. 134ᵃ</cite> (Ms. H. sing., Ms. R. <he>הַוָּיֵי</he>; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 40).
